hypotheses.justification: Proof without it: split on the sign of ε. If 0 < ε, use the existing proof unchanged. If ε ≤ 0, then ε/2 ≤ 0. By `WeightedIncidence.mass_nonneg u hu P` we have 0 ≤ mass u P, so ε/2 * mass u P ≤ 0 (`mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg`). Also 0 ≤ mass u Q by `mass_nonneg u hu Q`. So the conclusion holds in this case too. The degenerate case ε = 0 is included (the left side is 0). This argument does not use hR, so hε and hR can also both be removed together.

Proof without it: split on the sign of R. If 0 < R, use the existing proof. If R ≤ 0, then `mass_weight_mono w u hle P` together with hP gives mass u P ≤ mass w P ≤ R ≤ 0. Since ε/2 > 0 by hε, ε/2 * mass u P ≤ 0. Also 0 ≤ mass u Q by `WeightedIncidence.mass_nonneg u hu Q`. So the conclusion holds. (In fact R < 0 is already impossible: hle makes ∑(w a − u a) ≥ 0, while ε²/4 * R < 0, contradicting hloss.) This can be removed independently of hε, or together with it.
